user_confirmed.first_use_case: 收盘后判断回落时该买入还是继续等待
user_confirmed.confirmation_source: 本聊天2026-11-01用户选择，原文保留于本字段

proposed_primary_question: At the same decision-time information and starting cash, does a prespecified wait-for-confirmation policy improve common-endpoint net wealth and downside risk relative to buying at the next allowed window?

primary_comparison.A: next-allowed-window entry under a frozen execution policy
primary_comparison.B: wait for a frozen observable confirmation, then enter at its next allowed window, or stay in cash if no eligible entry occurs
primary_comparison.C: cash-only reference under the same declared cash-return assumption
primary_comparison.strict_advantage_event_for_definition_on: Delta_W > 0, ties separate; not an action threshold

wealth_conventions.cash_after_filled_round_trip: B - q*P_entry - F_entry + q*P_exit - F_exit, absent corporate actions and cash interest
wealth_conventions.terminal_NAV: cash_T + q_T*validated_mark_T + separately valued rights_and_receivables_T - unpaid_taxes_fees_and_other_liabilities_T; cash already reflects paid charges; no cash/receivable double counting

assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.starting_comparison_state: flat_cash_research_sleeve_only_proposed; not a statement that the actual account is flat
assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.focus: one cash-entry comparison first; held-position exits and intraday T separate
assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.clock: one horizon fixed on a planned exchange calendar known at the decision time; missing or suspended bars do not silently shift T
assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.horizon_discussion_example: 5 planned exchange sessions is an option for discussion, not confirmed and not selected from scores
assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.entry_window: next planned permitted window; no assumed close-price fill or after-hours channel
assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.endpoint: report NAV and sellability separately; if a cash-liquidation experiment is later chosen, keep failed liquidation unresolved rather than pretending NAV is cash
assistant_design_recommendations_not_fro.review_scope: definitions, timeline and synthetic counterexamples only
